title: A Mechanistic Study of Algorithmic Generalization in Diffusion Models on Modular Arithmetic
abstract: arXiv:2604.17673v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Despite their empirical success, how diffusion models generalize remains poorly understood from a mechanistic perspective. In this work, we provide a controlled mechanistic account of algorithmic learning in diffusion models. By utilizing the grokking phenomenon on an image-based modular addition task as a tractable testbed, we dissect the model's internal dynamics across two distinct visual regimes. In a single-image regime, mechanistic dissection reveals that the model implements modular addition by encoding operands as periodic representations and composing them at the self-attention--feedforward interface in a way that recovers the trigonometric addition identities. In a diverse-image regime with high intraclass variability, we find that the iterative sampling process partitions the task into an arithmetic computation phase and a subsequent visual refinement phase, with their transition precisely captured by an internal frequency

translated_title: 扩散模型在模运算上算法泛化的机制研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.17673v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：尽管扩散模型在实证上取得了巨大成功，但从机制角度对其泛化能力的理解仍然十分有限。在这项工作中，我们对扩散模型中的算法学习提供了一个受控的机制性解释。通过利用基于图像的模加法任务上的“顿悟”现象作为一个易于处理的测试平台，我们剖析了模型在两种不同视觉机制下的内部动态。在单图像机制下，机制剖析揭示出该模型通过将操作数编码为周期性表示，并在自注意力与前馈网络的接口处以一种恢复三角加法恒等式的方式对它们进行组合，从而实现模加法运算。在具有高类内多样性的多图像机制下，我们发现迭代采样过程将任务划分为一个算术计算阶段和一个随后的视觉精细化阶段，两者之间的转变被内部频率精确捕捉。
tldr: 该研究以模加法任务上的“顿悟”现象为测试平台，从机制上揭示了扩散模型的算法泛化方式：单图像场景下模型通过周期性表示编码操作数并在自注意力-前馈接口处按三角加法恒等式组合实现模加法，而高多样性多图像场景下迭代采样过程则被划分为算术计算与视觉精细化两个阶段。
en_tdlr: This work provides a mechanistic account of algorithmic generalization in diffusion models via grokking on an image-based modular addition task, showing that in the single-image regime the model encodes operands as periodic representations and composes them at the self-attention–feedforward interface to realize trigonometric addition identities, while in the diverse-image regime the iterative sampling process partitions the task into an arithmetic computation phase followed by a visual refinement phase.
